title: Role of TTV During First-line Immunotherapy Treatment in Patients With Renal Cell Carcinoma
official: Pilot Study to Describe the Role of TTV During First-line Immunotherapy Treatment in Patients With Renal Cell Carcinoma
summary: The aim of this project is to descriptively explore the trend of torquetenovirus viral load TTV during therapy with immune checkpoint inhibitor ICI in these patients, to evaluate a possible role of this virus as a biomarker of response.
